title: narcissus cypri
intro: Narcissus cypri, commonly known as the Narcissus pseudonarcissus or wild daffodil, is a perennial plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. The health benefits of Narcissus cypri include its potential to protect against neurodegenerative diseases due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to support cardiovascular health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus cypri include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential as an anticonvulsant and anti-anxiety agent. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus cypri include alkaloids, such as galanthamine, lycorine, and homochlorcyclizine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
